about.title: Integriteit | Deursigtigheid | Innovasie | Uitvoering
about.intro: ISPAY is gestig deur vroeë digitale-bate pioniers en tegnologie-spesialiste. Die kernleierskapspan bring ervaring van wêreldwye ondernemings soos Google, Microsoft, Facebook en ander toonaangewende tegnologie-organisasies.
about.p1: ISPAY kombineer diep ingenieursvermoë met bewese kundigheid om internetprodukte te bou en te skaal. As 'n fundamentele blockchain-infrastruktuurverskaffer lewer ISPAY veilige, voldoenende en hoëgehalte digitale batedienste vir gebruikers wêreldwyd.
about.p2: Gelei deur verantwoordelike innovasie, handhaaf ISPAY integriteit, billikheid en proaktiewe kliëntediens, terwyl oop samewerking met vennote bevorder word wat werklike waarde tot die globale digitale ekonomie bydra.

about.goalsIntro: The main objectives of the ISPAY program are to:
about.g1: Establish secure domestic and cross-border payment infrastructure;
about.g2: Enable regulated digital banking and card-based financial services;
about.g3: Provide transparent, auditable blockchain-based settlement mechanisms;
about.g4: Support interoperable financial systems compatible with existing banks;
about.g5: Expand financial inclusion at the population and enterprise levels;
about.g6: Preserve monetary sovereignty and regulatory control.
about.principlesIntro: The ISPAY program adheres to the following principles:
about.p1: Integrity: transparent and auditable financial operations;
about.p2: Compliance: compliance with national laws and regulations;
about.p3: Security: institutional-grade encryption and operational safeguards;
about.p4: Scalability: capacity to support national and regional development;
about.p5: Sovereignty: full national autonomy over deployment and oversight.
about.visionText: To build a borderless financial future where decentralized technology meets real-world utility.
about.missionText: To build compliant Web3 infrastructure connecting blockchains, assets, and people, enabling global participation in a unified digital economy.
about.remittanceSubtitle: Technical Brief: A hybrid decentralized infrastructure for regulated, high-volume cross-border payments
about.overviewText: The ISPAY Global Remittance system is built as a hybrid decentralized system that combines the interoperability of public blockchains with permissioned execution and governance layers, enabling high-volume, low-latency cross-border payments while maintaining regulatory control and operational reliability.
about.flawsIntro: The architecture avoids two common flaws of remittance systems:
about.flaw1: Fully centralized systems lack transparency and resilience;
about.flaw2: Fully permissionless systems lack compliance, governance, and deterministic control.

leadership.heading: Meet the leaders behind our success
leadership.name: Marcel Velez (ISPAY President)
leadership.p1: BRC-20, the world's fourth-largest protocol, is not just a technical milestone — it is the cornerstone of a global financial revolution. ISPay is building the world's first protocol-level interoperable ecosystem, enabling digital assets to move securely, transparently, and at scale across blockchains. This is mission-critical infrastructure designed for real-world use, with institutional-grade reliability and global reach. Today we serve 7 million users, on our way to 20 million, and growing under my leadership.
leadership.p2: Under my leadership, ISPay reaches every corner of the world, aiming to empower 20 million users in the near future and to build a financial ecosystem that transcends borders, cultures, and languages. From Asia to the Americas, from Europe to Africa, we are making decentralized, empowering financial tools universal, turning user participation into real value.
leadership.p3: At ISPay, our leadership team are pioneers. We launched the world's first ISPay token swap platform, enabling truly decentralized multi-chain native trading; we also launched the first ISPay on-chain mall, perfectly blending commerce and finance, with every transaction delivering full cashback, rewards, and meaningful financial participation.
leadership.p4: From ISPay Social (with over a million member communities and cities) to ISPay Wallet, Exchange, Games, and Mining, every product embodies our mission: empowering individuals, supporting businesses, and reshaping global finance.
leadership.p5: This is not just innovation — it is a movement reshaping how the world interacts with value, governance, and opportunity. ISPay turns everyday actions, social interactions, commerce, gaming, and financial participation into real on-chain impact. We do not wait for the future — we are the rails of the future, moving forward together, unstoppable.
leadership.p6: Our ISPay token is fully decentralized and compliant, powering this ecosystem and turning social, financial, and commercial activity into measurable impact.
